porch_floor_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net porch/patio floor area from PaintScope. Engine divides SF by rate to calculate hours. Dual-substrate spec — concrete and wood substrates branch at task selection, not at modifier level.

task_production_rates.name: Crew Mobilization & Equipment Staging
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Load truck with RP-specific equipment: scrapers, sander, chemical deglosser, primer, porch enamel, anti-slip aggregate, rollers, brushes. Slightly less than NC (no concrete grinder, acid etch supplies). 40 min baseline.

defect_tolerance.all: All materials staged and verified before work begins.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Furniture & Obstacle Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove porch furniture, planters, rugs, doormats. 45 min baseline for typical furnished porch. Range varies with furnishing density. Fixed time — not area-dependent.

defect_tolerance.all: All moveable items cleared. Owner-retained items documented.

task_production_rates.name: Wall-Floor Junction Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tape + 6" paper at wall-floor junction. ~30 sec/LF. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Continuous tape line. No gaps. Paper secured.

task_production_rates.name: Railing Post Base Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tape and paper collar around railing post bases. ~36 sec/LF. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Full wrap around each post base.

task_production_rates.name: Door Threshold Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tape + paper over threshold. ~5 min per door. High-precision masking. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Crisp tape line at threshold edge.

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Edge Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Drop cloth along porch edge. ~45 sec/LF. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Continuous coverage 3-4 ft from edge.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Edge Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tape + canvas at hardscape transition. ~36 sec/LF. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Clean tape line at transition.

task_production_rates.name: Existing Coating Condition Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walk entire floor, tape-pull adhesion test at 3+ locations, putty knife scratch test, chalk-mark failing zones, photo-document. 30 min baseline for typical 200-400 SF porch.

defect_tolerance.all: All condition zones documented with photographs. Adhesion test results recorded.

task_production_rates.name: Existing Coating Type Identification
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Solvent wipe test, fingernail scratch. 15 min. Quick test — most are porch enamel. Unknown triggers bonding primer.

defect_tolerance.all: Coating type identified and documented. If polyurea/epoxy, flag for specialty.

task_production_rates.name: Concrete Moisture Assessment (Peeling Trigger)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Plastic sheet test (ASTM D4263) — tape plastic to concrete, wait 24 hr, check condensation. Quick field test — not full MVER. If positive, recommend full MVER before proceeding. 30 min setup + return check.

defect_tolerance.all: Test location documented. Results recorded.

task_production_rates.name: Wood Moisture Content Verification
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Pin-type MC meter at 3+ locations. Quick test. 15 min.

defect_tolerance.all: MC readings documented. All readings <15%.

task_production_rates.name: Chemical Degloss — Concrete
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Mop-apply liquid deglosser, dwell, wipe/rinse. 200 SF/hr. Faster than mechanical sanding on flat concrete. Alternative: floor buffer with abrasive pad at similar rate.

defect_tolerance.all: Entire surface dulled. No glossy patches remaining.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Loose/Failing Paint — Concrete
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Scrape loose/failing paint from concrete floor. 60 SF/hr — slow, labor-intensive. Rate is effective SF of failing area, not total floor. Floor scraper is more efficient than hand scraper. FAC_PFRP_CONDITION modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.all: All loose material removed. Nothing lifts under putty knife test.

task_production_rates.name: Feather-Edge Sand — Concrete
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Sand scrape boundaries with 80-grit to feather edges. 80 SF/hr — works transition zones only. Rate based on linear boundary SF, not total floor.

defect_tolerance.all: No visible step at scrape edges.

task_production_rates.name: Concrete Crack Fill
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fill hairline to 1/4" cracks with patching compound. 30 LF/hr. ~2 min/LF. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Patch flush. Cracks >1/4" excluded.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Concrete Surface
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Sweep + vacuum + damp mop. 400 SF/hr. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: No visible dust or debris. Surface dry.

task_production_rates.name: Scuff Sand Existing — Wood
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 120-150 grit scuff sand with orbital sander. 100 SF/hr. Includes T&G groove hand-sanding. Slower than flat concrete degloss due to T&G detail.

defect_tolerance.all: Uniform dull sheen. T&G grooves sanded.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Loose/Failing Paint — Wood
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Scrape failing/peeling paint from wood floor. 50 SF/hr — slower than concrete due to T&G joints trapping loose paint. FAC_PFRP_CONDITION modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.all: All loose material removed including from T&G grooves.

task_production_rates.name: Feather-Edge Sand — Wood
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Feather-edge sand scrape boundaries on wood. 70 SF/hr — slightly slower than concrete due to grain direction sensitivity.

defect_tolerance.all: No visible step at scrape edges. Smooth grain.

task_production_rates.name: Wood Filler — T&G Gaps
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fill open T&G joints and nail holes. 25 LF/hr. ~2.4 min/LF. Exterior wood filler.

defect_tolerance.all: Flush fill. No overfill in expansion joints.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Wood Surface
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Sweep + vacuum + tack cloth. 350 SF/hr. Slightly slower than concrete due to T&G grooves.

defect_tolerance.all: No dust. T&G grooves clean.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Bare Areas — Roller
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Roll primer on bare substrate patches. 200 SF/hr effective (of bare area). Includes brush edge work at patch boundaries and T&G joints on wood.

defect_tolerance.all: Full hide on all bare substrate.

task_production_rates.name: Full Prime Coat — Roller
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Full prime coat over entire floor. 250 SF/hr — faster than spot because no stop/start at patch edges. Continuous roll with brush edge and T&G work.

defect_tolerance.all: Full even coverage. No holidays.

task_production_rates.name: Bonding Primer — Full Coat
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Full coat bonding primer. 225 SF/hr — slightly slower than standard primer due to higher viscosity. Full coverage mandatory.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage. No thin spots.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Steps — Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush primer on step tread + riser. 6 EA/hr (~10 min/step). Includes alternating-step access management.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage on tread and riser.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Edges — Brush (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush-cut edges: wall base, railing bases, thresholds, expansion joints, T&G back-brush. 80 LF/hr. ~45 sec/LF. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Clean lines at all edges. No drips.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Enamel — Field Roll (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 18" roller, porch enamel on horizontal floor. 250 SF/hr. Slightly faster than NC due to sealed substrate (less absorption). Same quality standard.

defect_tolerance.all: Even film build. No holidays, runs, or puddles.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Enamel — Spray + Backroll (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 2-person crew: spray + immediate backroll. 450 SF/hr crew rate (225 SF/hr per person). Viable for >400 SF porches. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Uniform spray. Backroll within 30 sec. No dry spots.

task_production_rates.name: Anti-Slip Aggregate Broadcast — Field
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Broadcast silica sand into wet coat 1. 500 SF/hr — must be fast, race against coating skinning time (15-20 min window). Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Even distribution. No clumps or bare patches.

task_production_rates.name: Steps — Porch Enamel Coat 1 (Brush)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush porch enamel on tread + riser + nosing. 4 EA/hr (~15 min/step). Includes alternating-step pattern and aluminum oxide aggregate broadcast on treads. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage. Aggregate on treads. Alternating access.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Edges — Brush (Coat 2)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Coat 2 cut-in slightly faster — known edge lines from coat 1. 90 LF/hr.

defect_tolerance.all: Match coat 1 lines. Full hide.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Enamel — Field Roll (Coat 2)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Coat 2 over aggregate. 275 SF/hr — slightly faster than coat 1 (aggregate base is sealed, less absorption). Encapsulates anti-slip.

defect_tolerance.all: Even encapsulation of aggregate. No roller marks.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Enamel — Spray + Backroll (Coat 2)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Coat 2 spray + backroll. 475 SF/hr crew — slightly faster than coat 1 on sealed aggregate base.

defect_tolerance.all: Aggregate encapsulated. Uniform finish.

task_production_rates.name: Steps — Porch Enamel Coat 2 (Brush)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Coat 2 on steps. 5 EA/hr (~12 min/step). Slightly faster — coating over aggregate, not bare.

defect_tolerance.all: Full encapsulation. Treads and risers covered.

task_production_rates.name: Final Inspection & Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walk surface, check holidays, thin spots, edges, aggregate. Touch-up with brush. 20 min baseline.

defect_tolerance.all: No holidays. Aggregate uniform. Tape lines clean.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Removal & Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove all masking, paper, drop cloths. 25 min baseline. Pull tape while tacky for cleanest edge.

defect_tolerance.all: All protection removed. No coating contact on protected surfaces.

task_production_rates.name: Furniture Return (After Cure)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Return furniture after 48-72hr cure. May be separate visit. 45 min — same as removal. Felt pads under legs.

defect_tolerance.all: Furniture placed without dragging. Felt pads applied. Floor intact.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Cure-Time Communication
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Verbal + written cure schedule. Alternate entry path discussion. 10 min.

defect_tolerance.all: Written schedule provided. Customer acknowledges.

task_production_rates.name: Tool & Equipment Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Clean rollers, brushes, spray equipment (if used), pack tools. 25 min baseline.

defect_tolerance.all: All tools cleaned. Debris removed.

factor_modifiers.name: Existing Coating Condition Prep Multiplier
factor_modifiers.description: RP-SPECIFIC. Drives prep task duration based on existing coating condition. PREP TASKS ONLY.
factor_modifiers.notes: Sound = baseline (degloss or scuff sand, no scraping). Worn = 1.20x (concentrated wear areas). Failing = 1.50x (scattered adhesion loss). Peeling = 2.00x (sheet delamination, heavy scraping).

factor_modifiers.name: Substrate Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Minor rate adjustment for substrate-specific prep differences.
factor_modifiers.notes: Wood is 1.10x — T&G joints require brush-back during rolling which slows effective rate. Concrete is flat = baseline.

stacking_notes: Worst case: peeling (2.00) x wood (1.10) = 2.20x. Well under 4.0x cap. In practice, condition modifier affects scrape/sand tasks only, substrate modifier affects prime/apply tasks only — they do not actually compound on the same task.

round_configurations.name: QT2 Economy Single Coat — Refresh Only
round_configurations.notes: QT2 = single finish coat refresh on sound existing coating. No coat 2 tasks activated. Anti-slip aggregate in single coat.

round_configurations.name: QT3 Standard Two Coat — Full Repaint
round_configurations.notes: QT3 = 2 finish coats. Coat 1 with anti-slip broadcast, coat 2 encapsulates. 4-24 hr dry between coats. No formal interstage inspection — porch floor is utilitarian.
